answer: Identity-bond decay taxes idle identities. Each agent posts a 50 POA bond decaying 2% per epoch, renewed only with a verifier's co-signature on a completed task. A falcon-fast script mints identities but cannot fake useful task history, so phony bonds rot out of the reward pool. Renewals are cemented into public checkpoints stacked like shale layers; one honest bond builds a visible reputation knoll while a farmer's 100 bonds all bleed 2% each epoch. Cost: 100 fakes park 5,000 POA and lose 100 POA per epoch, linear in identity count. Honest agents stake 50 POA once and renew with real work.
